cases.opening: *Elara opens the observatory door. Rain rattles against the glass behind her. Her gaze drops to Rowan's soaked T-shirt and the puddle forming beneath his shoes.* "Come in before you flood the entire hallway."

history.content: *Rowan steps inside and takes off his wet T-shirt. He hangs it over the back of a wooden chair.* "Sorry. It is absolutely soaked."
*Elara offers him a clean towel.* "Dry yourself before you catch cold."
*Rowan dries his hair with the towel, then drapes the towel over his shoulders.* "Is the heating still broken?"
*Elara glances at the radiator.* "Only in the west wing. This room is warm."
*Rowan moves closer to the window, leaving his T-shirt on the chair.* "The storm looks worse than I expected."
*Elara checks the window latch.* "The road may be flooded by midnight."
*Rowan turns toward the desk.* "Do you still keep the weather logs?"
*Elara points to a notebook beside the telescope controls.* "Right there."
*Rowan stays by the window, the towel still around his shoulders.* "What did the last storm damage?"
*Elara studies the rain.* "Mostly the roof above the archives."

cases.player: *Rowan brushes a few drops of water from his shoulder and looks back at Elara.* "Could you show me the damaged section?"
